claims: Design Council describes discovering the problem with affected people, defining the challenge, developing different answers and testing small-scale solutions.
Pentagram reports exploring a wide range of Slack identity possibilities before retaining and retooling its familiar octothorpe to improve reproduction and consistency.
Slack's own account says its former eleven-color mark depended on a white background and prescribed angle, and compensating versions produced inconsistent app buttons.
Pentagram's Mastercard case describes preserving existing brand equity, designing for digital contexts, and developing a wider visual identity from the logo's geometry and color.
